findings.current: Worse, I couldn’t deny what he said.
findings.defect: “Worse” adds a negative judgment that the source does not make. The source says Baeksang was unusually candid and that his words were undeniable, not that the latter fact made the situation worse.
findings.rationale: 한편으로는 connects the statements with “at the same time” or “on the other hand”; it does not establish that the undeniable facts are worse.
findings.replacement: At the same time, I couldn’t deny the facts behind his words.

findings.current: The result of that life-and-death duel that shook heaven and earth was the Martial God’s victory.
findings.defect: The assembled copy omits the preceding image, “the clash of two absolute beings,” which the source states explicitly and the accepted baseline preserves.
findings.rationale: 두 절대자의 격돌 is an explicit description of the clash, not merely another way to describe the duel’s result.
findings.replacement: The clash between two absolute beings. The result of that life-and-death duel that shook heaven and earth was the Martial God’s victory.

findings.current: I swallowed the words that tried to burst out of me.
findings.defect: The source says the remark pierced the narrator’s ears as he instinctively swallowed his reaction. The assembled copy drops that image, which the accepted baseline preserves.
findings.rationale: 귓가를 파고드는 한 마디 describes the remark as piercing the narrator’s ears; it is a source image omitted from the current version.
findings.replacement: At the words that pierced my ears, I instinctively swallowed the words trying to burst out of me.

summary: The translation is broadly faithful, with a few minor shifts and omissions from the source and accepted baseline.
